visual_text: A one-page plan for if you are suddenly ill
Practical advice, not a research finding
Six things to put on the page
Their medicines, and where they are kept
Who to call first, and who second
Keys, and how to get in
Give a copy to each person named on it. Ask your council or a local carers' centre whether they can help you write one.
Practical advice. No research finding or legal entitlement is claimed.
alt_text: Checklist card: a one-page plan for if you are suddenly ill. Six things to put on it: their name and main needs; their medicines and where they are kept; who to call first and second; keys and how to get in; their daily routine; their GP and pharmacy. Give a copy to each person named. Practical advice, not a research finding.
design_instructions: Checklist card: six tick boxes in a panel, mint instruction panel; practical advice, no claims.
